about_the_game:
Forehead Chip is a 2D cyberpunk pixel-platformer set within a dystopian city split between those who implant chips in their hands. Join the Implant Corps and capture uncooperative deviants living within the forsaken cracks and crevices of society. Explore the divided city’s secrets, whispers, and inner tensions and earn your worth as a recruit seeking to win the coveted Forehead Chip, the key that will give you ultimate status and access.

Introducing unique capturing and bullet collecting mechanics, play this nostalgic shooter that encourages skillful precision and chaotic action in a variety of stages, enemies, and obstacles. Engage in an ever-evolving narrative that affects your gameplay style and dynamics. Explore a steamy and detailed cyberpunk cityscape where discoveries and revelations uncover your place in this world.

Travel across the divided Arca City, where half the population have accepted digital implants to access basic services, as well as higher luxuries. While beyond the harbour in the disobedient Holdout Districts, vagrants needing ‘liberation’ roam the city’s neglected wastes, urban dwellings, and industrial areas. Leave no stone unturned, as Holdouts use ingenious means to hide and arm themselves.

Play as young Chip, a recruit in the Implant Corps, and prove your worth to your friends and family by winning the coveted one-of-a-kind implant model: the Forehead Chip. Delve into a variety of unique locations, interact with characters across the political map, and let your actions dictate your future.

But once you dent the shiny surface of Arca City, everything is not as it seems, as unexpected paths to victory will open up for you.

  • Drop and venture into the besieged city districts through frantic action platforming with tight, tuned and responsive controls.

  • Wield a variety of uniquely controlled weapons and ammo upgrades to capture scores of Holdouts, bosses, and robots to mark your score on the Implant Corps leaderboard.

  • With unique capturing and bullet-collecting gameplay, Forehead Chip offers new twists and thrilling moments for a classic genre.

  • Join the Corps in Singleplayer or in Two-Player CO-OP to compete and capture chipless Holdouts in the main story.

  • Recruit your friends in a 2-4 Player PVP Arena Multiplayer with over a dozen playable maps and competitive modes.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: glibc 2.17+, 32/64-bit
  • Processor: 2.0+ GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0+ (2.1 with ARB extensions acceptable)
  • Storage: 750 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Recommended, not Required

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Lion 10.7.5, 32/64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 M380
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0+ (2.1 with ARB extensions acceptable)
  • Storage: 750 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Recommended, not Required
